name: hxn
description: The Haxe classes of libraries built with hxn: futures, streams, signals, reactive values, shared logging, atomics, and the macro that binds a packaged library.
releasenote: hxn build writes an APK for an Android program with the hxn-window host, signed with the debug key, and -D hxn_android_permissions lists the permissions it asks for.
